## A slide you work as well as read {#controls-one}

A lecture deck's slides are not all inert. This one carries the shapes ACTL2131
puts on its "In R" slides -- a range the audience watches being swept, and a
button that redraws a sample -- so that what a pen in hand does to them is
something the suite can state rather than something a lecture discovers.

<input class="fixture-range" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="40">

<button class="fixture-button" type="button">Resample</button>
